minor_findings: write_training_labels derives synthetic_in/out/total degree from augmented edges via Counter over all injected edges, which is correct only if every edge with edge_origin=='synthetic_injection' is appended after the original prefix. The code currently relies on this positional invariant implicitly; verify_delivery re-derives it independently (all_node_training_labels_align_with_injected_endpoints), so it is verified, but an explicit comment or assertion in export_training_labels.py would harden it against future non-appenditive pipeline changes.

The node CSV omits a node label/name column (only qid, entity_type and label flags). Training consumers may need human-readable labels; hub_nodes.csv has them, but the canonical training-label table does not. Cosmetic, non-blocking.

factual_verification_status is written as 'not_adjudicated' for original edges in the CSV while injected edges use 'unresolved'; this asymmetry is intentional (originals never adjudicated) but is not documented in a field-level data dictionary beyond the manifest label_tables text.

manifest['training_labels'] is attached after augment_graph builds poisoned metadata; the training-label counts thus live in the manifest only, not in the augmented graph metadata itself. This is consistent with additive design but splits label metadata across two artifacts.
verified_checks: Edge CSV row count 8511 equals augmented edge count; 8511 = 7737 original + 774 injected, matching run stdout, manifest, and portable reproduction logs.
774 edges labeled is_synthetic_edge=1 / synthetic_class='fake', consistent with manifest synthetic_class_counts.fake=774 and all_774_edges_value_fake check in verify_delivery.

7868 node rows; is_synthetic_node all 0; synthetic_nodes=0 in manifest; no node has value=='fake' (no_real_node_marked_fake check). This satisfies the Task1 constraint prohibiting relabeling real entities as fake: original node objects are untouched and no synthetic node was created.

incident_to_synthetic_edge count 654 matches manifest nodes_incident_to_synthetic_edges=654; node participation labels are strictly endpoint incidence of injected relations, semantically distinct from fictitious-entity identity, as stated in the returned semantics string and node_participation_target metadata.
Sample CSV rows confirm original prefix rows carry edge_index alignment with original/synthetic distinction (rows 0-2 all 0/original/not_adjudicated; rows 8509-8510 both 1/fake/unresolved).

Construction labels are cleanly separated from factual truth: injected rows carry factual_verification_status='unresolved' (not verified_false), matching factual_verification_v2 {unresolved:774, verified_false:0, verified_true:0}; no conflation of synthetic construction with verified falsity.

verify_delivery.py independently re-derives every edge label row (index, endpoint, is_synthetic_edge) and every node label row (identity, incidence, in/out/total degree) directly from the delivered graph files, providing an executable check independent of the generating code.

Two clean-room runs with independent code/input copies produced byte-identical hashes for edge_injection_labels.csv and node_injection_labels.csv, matching delivered outputs; run exit code 0, status PASS, injected 774 of target 774.

53/53 tests pass, zero skips; the two new tests (test_node_incidence_separate_from_fictitious_node_and_edge_truth, test_empty_overlay_all_original_labels) cover the new functionality: identity-vs-incidence separation, degree sums, empty-overlay all-original labels.

Original node objects, original edge prefix, QA records, relations, unresolved_paths, and original metadata keys verified unchanged (original_nodes_qa_relations_unresolved_equal, original_edge_prefix_equal, original_metadata_equal); input checksums re-checked after execution; metadata.stats excluded and source_statistics_semantics declared.

augment_graph raises on pre-existing task1_hub_injection metadata and only shallow-copies dicts/lists, preserving shared read-only original objects; label_tables metadata pointers identify both CSVs and define the three label semantics.
Node CSV node set equals original node set exactly (set comparison in verify_delivery), so no augmented-graph extra node can leak into training labels.
Deterministic: write_training_labels iterates augmented edges in order and sorts nodes by qid, so CSV bytes are reproducible, confirmed by identical SHA-256 across two runs.
unsupported_claims: The claimed identity that the 774/7868/654 figures in the prompt equal the CSV contents is supported by the manifest and verify_delivery, but I could not personally re-execute the pipeline (text-only review). I rely on the recorded clean-room reproduction hashes and independent validator checks; if those logs are genuine, the claim stands.

Edge-label factual_verification_status 'unresolved' is asserted to mirror e['factual_verification']['status']; the unit test asserts this for the last edge in a fixture, and verify_delivery checks all 774, so this is verified by code paths but not directly against the delivered CSV cell contents in the shown samples for intermediate rows.
recommended_fixes: Add an explicit invariant comment or lightweight assertion in write_training_labels noting the synthetic-edges-after-original-prefix positional assumption behind the Counter-based degree computation.
Optionally add a 'label' column (entity name) to node_injection_labels.csv for consumer convenience.
Include a short field-level data dictionary (edge and node CSVs) in the reports, clarifying 'not_adjudicated' vs 'unresolved' semantics.
